label: Updated 12 PM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Sam Burns leads RBC Canadian Open
items.text: Sam Burns leads the RBC Canadian Open at 7-under after three holes, one stroke ahead of Erik van Rooyen, Emiliano Grillo, Brooks Koepka, and Doug Ghim all at 6-under.

items.headline: Scheffler aims for US Open history
items.text: Scottie Scheffler is preparing to make history at the upcoming 2026 US Open at Shinnecock Hills.

items.headline: Mickelson ousted from San Diego club
items.text: Phil Mickelson was removed from The Farms Golf Club in Rancho Santa Fe after a female employee reported nonconsensual physical contact, prompting an investigation and decisive club action.
